notes: Scope package: docsys-wp-information-architecture (Documentation Information Architecture Decision), deliveryOrder=1. Approved residual decision for execution: contributor governance entry should be root-level CONTRIBUTING.md unless ImplementationDesign evidence blocks it. Repository evidence during this stage still found no D:/Projects/Argo/CONTRIBUTING.md.

Approved residual decision for execution: do not invent a root OVERALL_ARCHITECTURE.md if absent; documentation must handle the root contract honestly as a gap. The intent graph already models docsys-root-contract-gap as residual coordination and forbids pretending the root contract exists.
